paragraphs: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai; Ulla ben Zakkai ([Chullin 52a, according to the reading of Tosafot](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Chullin.52a.21.1), s.v. "ne'ekra"); Rabbi Pinchas ben Zakkai ([Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Moed_Katan.2.1.4)).[^1]

notes.text: Tosafot on Chullin 52a, s.v. נעקרה צלע טרפה, reads Ulla bar Rabbi Zakkai. Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:1 names Rabbi Pinchas be-Rabbi Zakkai. These particular title forms are not silently substituted for Hyman’s labels or merged into one identity.
